name: application-usage-meter
title: Usage Meter Card
description: Quota tiles with used-versus-limit progress, threshold color shifts, and an upgrade call to action for billing and plan usage surfaces.
useWhen: Quota tiles with used-versus-limit progress, threshold color shifts, and an upgrade call to action for billing and plan usage surfaces.
avoidWhen: Avoid usage meter card when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Usage Meter Card uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
